## SQL & R reports

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .project-card}
### Premier League Scouting Report
**SQL · R · ggplot2**

I queried a database of 5 European leagues across 7 seasons (about 12,700 matches) to find out what
wins games and which players to sign. The two strongest team-level stats, chance quality created
and chance quality allowed, explain about 82% of the variation in points between teams. I then built
a composite score to rank 1,065 players from outside the Premier League and recommended a shortlist
of five.

[Read the report (PDF) →](files/Football-Scouting-Report.pdf) · [See the SQL →](projects/football-sql.qmd)
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .project-card}
### Hospital Operations Review
**SQL · R · ggplot2**

I analyzed records of 1,500 patients, 1,000 surgeries, 2,000 stays, and 500 nurses to answer three
questions from leadership: which surgeries are most common, how long patients stay, and which nurses
carry the heaviest workloads. One key finding: the 17% of stays longer than a week account for 46%
of all bed-days, which points to discharge planning as the best way to free up beds.

[Read the report (PDF) →](files/Hospital-Operations-Report.pdf) · [See the SQL →](projects/hospital-sql.qmd)
:::
